en: "So you have noticed it too, Toryu.{n} Indeed, this presence is a flow of ki{n} filled with evil, murderous intent."
"As you will..."
"Hey, what have you two been{n} talking about?"
"Pardon my rudeness. However, you,{n} Sir {hero:6}, must surely have{n} noticed it long ago."
"The evil ki we have felt for some{n} time now... what do you make of it?"
"Yeah, true..."
"It's mixed in with the crowd, but I've{n} felt a piercing bloodlust{n} ever since we entered town."
"As expected of a knight of the West."
"Ummm, ummm, ummm?"
"Kee? Ki? Key? Is thaat it?"
"I haven't got the faintest ideaaa?"
"As expected of a knight of the West."
"More to the point, do you have{n} any idea who it is?"
"Sir {hero:6}, will you accept{n} us as your comrades?"
"What's this, all of a sudden?"
"Please tell me.{n} Will you accept us as comrades?"
"Guess so..."
"You're my comrades"
"I've got no comrades"
"Well, I'm not the type to have{n} comrades, but we've fought together{n} this far. I guess you can call us that."
"I see. I, too, am glad{n} to hear those words..."
"Too bad, but I don't have any{n} such thing as comrades.{n} Not anywhere in this world..."
"I see. That is truly a pity..."
"What are you talking abooout!{n} Mr. {hero:6} is just{n} a shy one, that's aaall!"
"Shy, me!?"
"Just think about iiit!"
"Do you think he would hunt the precious{n} rings of the Twelve Gods with total{n} strangers who aren't even comraaades!?"
"Now that you mention it, that is true."
"I'm sure that deep down,{n} Mr. {hero:6} accepts you and the{n} others as comrades too, Mr. Ozunuuu!"
"Is that true?"
"Tch. At her age, and she still{n} shrieks like a brat.{n} What a noisy old lady."
"Well, which is it, Sir {hero:6}?"
"Well, I guess most people would call{n} this being comrades. I see it{n} a little differently, though..."
"That gladdens me..."
"Ummm, what are you talking abooout?"
"Pardon my rudeness. However, you,{n} Lady {name:6}, must surely have{n} noticed it long ago."
"The evil ki we have felt for some{n} time now... what do you make of it?"
"Kee? Ki? Key? Is thaat it?"
"Ummm, ummm, ummm?"
"Whatever do you meeean?"
"I see. As expected of Lady {name:6}.{n} Bloodlust of this degree does not{n} seem to shake you in the least."
"She's just dense."
"That's meeean!"
"...It's true, though."
"But really, what is iiit?"
"Lady {name:6}, will you accept{n} us as your comrades?"
"Huh? What's this, all of a suddeeen?"
"Please tell me.{n} Will you accept us as comrades?"
"Well, thaat's..."
"Of course I do"
"That's hard to answer"
"What are you saying at this pooint?{n} You're irreplaceable comrades who{n} have traveled all this way with meee."
"I see. I, too, am very glad{n} to hear those words."
"Being asked that all of a sudden,{n} it's a little hard to answeeer..."
"No, I am the one who must apologize,{n} for troubling you, Lady {name:6}."
"But I understand your feelings well,{n} Lady {name:6}. To give no answer{n} is itself one answer."
"Though it is a great pity."
"Heh, what are you talking about, Ozunu?"
"What do you mean?"
"Try to see how this old lady feels."
"If she comes right out and says you're{n} comrades, she drags you travelers from{n} the East down an even deadlier road."
"That's what this old lady can't stand."
"Is that true, Lady {name:6}?"
"Eh? Eh? Eh? Eeeeeh?"
"H-how come?{n} Mr. {hero:6}?
Oh, could it be you have a skill{n} that lets you read people's miiinds!?"
"Are you stupid? At your age,{n} going bright red in the face{n} like some little girl."
"That's why what you're thinking gets{n} read right away. No mind reading{n} needed."
"Oh? Oh my, oh my, oh myyy?{n} So that's how it waaas?{n} I never noticed until nooow?"
"Then, Sir {hero:6}...?"
"Yeah. Looks like this good-natured{n} old lady thinks of you guys{n} as precious comrades."
"I see. I, too, am very glad{n} to hear those words."
"Oh! Come to think of it, Mr. Ozunu,{n} what's this killing intent you've{n} been so intent on for a whiiile?"
"Intent on... killing intent..."
"Oh, that wasn't a pun, reallyyy!{n} It was a coincidence! Pleeease,{n} you have to believe meee!"
"Shut up. Keep quiet for a bit!"
"Sniff..."
"Before I explain in detail..."
"This is not a fitting place for it.{n} I am sorry to ask, but would you{n} come with me to the edge of town?"
"Yeah, somewhere with no people is{n} better. Our guest probably{n} wants it that way too..."
"Our guest?"
"Whoever's giving off that bloodlust."
"Then, let us go."
"This should be far enough."
"Well, then..."
"Why do you not show yourself?{n} The flow of ki tells me{n} that you are hiding there."
"What is that...?"
"It's my first time seeing one in{n} the flesh, but that looks like a ninja."
"Professional killers. Along with{n} the samurai, they're known as{n} the warriors of the East."
"A ninja... is iiit?"
"Skilled with a blade, quick on their{n} feet, masters of all kinds of killing{n} moves. Think of a special forces unit."
"So it was you after all."
"Tsuchimikado, wielder of darkness."
"What are you thinking, Prince Ozunu?{n} The mission your father the Emperor{n} gave you... have you forgotten it!?"
"To restore the nations of the East,{n} trampled by the powers of Europea!{n} And to revive our imperial court!"
"To cleverly approach the ring bearers,{n} catch them off guard, take their lives{n} and seize every ring! That mission!"
"Have you forgotten it!?"
"At first, I had not forgotten."
"But as I traveled on with the people{n} here, a thought suddenly came to me."
"Whatever their country or race, these{n} people seek the Almighty Treasure{n} only for what they each believe in."
"And compared with them, what am I?"
"Have you forgotten, Prince Ozunu!"
"You are the Emperor's first prince!{n} To revive our court... no, the nations{n} of the East... that is your mission!"
"Comrades..."
"What did you say?"
"These people accept me as a comrade.{n} Me, who is not of their country,{n} whose skin and hair differ in color."
"That, too, is a word of the vulgar{n} world! A prince is the nation itself!{n} He does not mingle with base humans!"
"The mingling of base humans crosses{n} borders. One day, with no East or West,{n} people will be bound tightly together..."
"That is what I have come to believe."
"How foolish..."
"The poison of the vulgar world{n} has tainted you, Prince!"
"Poison and medicine are nearly the{n} same thing. It is no more than{n} a matter of yin and yang."
"...Just so, Prince.{n} ...How well you have grown."
"...I, too, will follow you anywhere."
"So a fallen dynasty deserves{n} a fallen prince, after all..."
"Then!"
"I will cut down the poison-soaked{n} prince! Then I will return home and{n} cut down the aged Emperor as well!"
"And my house of Tsuchimikado shall{n} become the new emperors! For the{n} revival and restoration of the East!"
"We will wipe the barbaric Westerners{n} off the face of the earth!"
"I see. So that's how it is."
"Please stand back, Sir {hero:6}.{n} This is my own personal fight."
"Sorry to butt in, but no. I've always{n} wanted to cross swords with a ninja,{n} if only once."
"Gets the blood pumping, doesn't it?{n} Cutting some tough-looking guy{n} clean in two with my sword..."
"Sir {hero:6}..."
"All right, let's go!"
"...As you will."
"So that's how it iiis..."
"Please stand back, Lady {name:6}.{n} This is my own personal fight."
"I can't do thaat. After all,{n} we're comrades, aren't weee?"
"Lady {name:6}..."
"We're up against a crack ninja.{n} I'm not confident, but let's try."
"...As you will."
"Ninja are fast, so watch out!{n} Get in formation and tighten{n} your defenses!"
"Ninja use all sorts of moves.{n} Everyone, please fight with care!"
"Be especially wary of Tsuchimikado!{n} That man is a Shadow Master. He excels{n} at sorcery that uses shadows!"
"...Yet with the Prince's strength,{n} he is by no means beyond defeat."
"...Now I will tell you."
"...Your father the Emperor himself{n} charged me to be your watcher."
"...With orders to cut you down{n} should you stray from the path."
"So it was as I thought.{n} That is just like my father."
"...But the path you chose, Prince, is{n} the true way of kings. The way of{n} rule that overflows with virtue."
"...Let us go, Prince. To build{n} a true paradise of righteous rule{n} upon this earth."
"It's all right, Lt. {hero:6}, sir!{n} Your orders are always on the mark!{n} We'll win this fight for sure!"
"To think that people of the distant{n} West and East would fight on such a{n} small island in the Sea of Avalon..."
"East or West, are human beings{n} simply fond of fighting{n} by nature, after all...?"
"If so, it is far too sad."
"Ninja... pro killers, huh...{n} ...But... the way they move...{n} somehow... it's like me..."
"No... it can't be..."
"This feels very dangerous, yes indeed!{n} But leave it to Li'l Tethys! She will{n} try very, very hard, if you please!"
"C'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon!{n} Hey, ninja scum! Don't you{n} ever stop moving!"
"One second!"
"Stand still for even one second, and{n} the great Parsifal's heavy MG{n} will fill you lot full of holes!"
"Good, we push through just like this!{n} Show those ninja{n} what we're really made of!"
"Ninja really are tough!{n} Everyone, don't let your guard down!"
"As expected of the shadow clan that{n} served my imperial house for ages.{n} Splendid skill! But I will not lose!"
"This fight is not for the nation,{n} nor for the people. It is a fight{n} to settle things with myself!"
"If I lose the fight with myself,{n} then even on the throne I could{n} lead neither nation nor people!"
"Damned Westerners, they are good!"
"But this art of the Tsuchimikado house{n} gathers the secret arts of the East.{n} Can you withstand it...?"
"High energy reading around enemy body!"
"Not a sensor fault. But to focus{n} this much high energy{n} with spirit power alone?"
"This is extremely dangerous. The enemy{n} is about to unleash a tremendous move."
"What on earth is he planning!?{n} What do we do, sir!?{n} Special Service 2nd Lt. {hero:6}!?"
"Mmmmmmmmm!? I've got{n} a nasty feeling about this!{n} The Professor's hunch says so!"
"Prince {hero:6}, look out!{n} That man's gonna use an amazing move!"
"That man means to loose a fearsome art.{n} It is neither magic nor psychic power,{n} but some other force I know not."
"Gh... ooooh... what!?"
"We, the clan called Tsuchigumo...{n} ...staking our revival... stole{n} in secret... into the court, yet..."
"Were we... our clan... fated...{n} ...to perish... after all?"
"A paradise of righteous rule... Very{n} well... build it... on the corpses...{n} of ruined peoples like us..."
"Someday... once more... we shall..."
"...Clan, he says?"
"Taking pride in your bloodline now{n} and then is fine. But sometimes{n} it also becomes the spark of a fight."
"Gods, peoples, nations...{n} Why are humans so eager to{n} come up with things to fight over?"
"Someday all blood will mix together,{n} and race, lineage and peoples will be{n} gone. I wish such a day would come."
"Is that just a fairy tale, I wonder."
"Kin, peoples... the kinds that{n} humans themselves have laid down."
"Yet if we are all the same humans,{n} it stands to reason we can understand{n} each other, though it take millennia."
"I want to build such a world..."
"...As you will."
"All right! We've wiped out the ninja!"
"Phew, looks like we managed to wiiin."
"Thank you very much..."
"Now I, too, can continue the journey{n} with all of you,{n} never to waver again."
"Not as the prince of Japone, but as{n} one person who wishes for peace{n} for the people."
"...Well done, Prince... However..."
"...You are still far too soft!"
"No way!? I was sure we beat him!"
"He came back to life!?{n} Is he immortal?"
"No, that is the Utsusemi technique!"
"It is nothing more than a smokescreen."
"You call my secret art a smokescreen?"
"But, Prince... can you still{n} talk so big{n} after this?"
"That ate up a lot of time. Oh well,{n} for today I'll just take it easy{n} and do some shopping in town."
"Still, that was tiiiring. I'd like to{n} shop in town or something and{n} take it niiiiice and easy."
"Shadow Clones!"
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
